data_format_assessment.summary: For the Geologix Vanguard tender monitoring database, the recommended data collection architecture is: (1) OCDS JSON API from eTenders for government tenders, (2) web scraping for mining house portals (no API available), (3) paid aggregator subscription (ProTenders recommended) for private sector and municipal gap-filling, (4) direct email submission monitoring for AEMFC.

recommended_architecture.tier_1_api: OCDS REST API from data.etenders.gov.za — automated ingest of all government tenders
recommended_architecture.tier_2_scrape: Weekly scrape of: AEMFC (aemfc.co.za), Sibanye public tender list, Implats RFI page, CoJ, Tshwane, Ekurhuleni, Cape Town municipal portals
recommended_architecture.tier_3_paid_aggregator: ProTenders subscription — covers private mining house tenders, remaining municipal portals, and acts as gap-fill for portals that are scrape-difficult
recommended_architecture.tier_4_email_alerts: TenderAlerts daily digest + TendersOnTime for mining machinery category
recommended_architecture.tier_5_direct_portals: Register on Coupa (Sibanye, Glencore Alloys), SAP Ariba (Implats, Valterra/Amplats, Anglo American), to receive direct tender invitations
